text: SUPERVISOR: USER live verdicts on the collision wave, verbatim: "staircase = works, ramp = i cant walk up it, camera cant brake if i cant walk up it so i cant answer to if it still does. it doesnt on the staircase tho". Determine which FIRST: confirm what native build id the live session reports vs disk, then print the ramp ascent data live-shaped — player position, the surface the resolver selects underfoot, the slope/walkableSlopeCos values the step sees as the player pushes into the ramp (the register log showed walkableSlopeCos 0.6 — if the slab's slope exceeds the walkable threshold the resolver calls it a wall and you get exactly this). Read the prints, fix, and your live-shaped regression must include ASCENT (walk up the ramp to the top), not just under/beside. Camera-on-ramp stays unanswerable until ascent works — sequence it after.
